name: Guarinisuchus
sum: Guarinisuchus is a dyrosaurid crocodylomorph from the Danian Maria Farinha Formation of north-eastern Brazil.
wsnote: Probably about 3 m long (English Wikipedia); an estimate.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted; named from the Maria Farinha Formation, Brazil (Barbosa et al. 2008).
material: The sources consulted do not list the material.
biology: A marine dyrosaurid; a 2026 study (Izidio and colleagues) examined its dental histology. The sources consulted give no more on diet.
author: Barbosa et al. 2008

sources.text: Barbosa, J. A., Kellner, A. W. A. and Viana, M. S. S. 2008. New dyrosaurid crocodylomorph and evidences for faunal turnover at the K-P transition in Brazil. Proceedings of the Royal Society B 275(1641): 1385–1391.
Izidio, M. E., de Araújo, E. V., Haase, M. V., Sayão, J. M. and Oliveira, G. R. 2026. Dental histology of Guarinisuchus munizi (Crocodylomorpha, Dyrosauridae). Historical Biology 38(10): 4118–4130.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences under this name. Age is the Danian (Early Palaeocene, about 62 Ma) of the ICS chart, from the English Wikipedia.
